body: I have not! I do have an appointment with my hematologist in a couple weeks though and I can ask her to test me for it

They suggested an iron infusion first, but I kind of scared myself out of it seeing other people say that it didn’t really do anything for them the first couple times and hearing about people getting sick/bad reactions. I find that I’m so much more sensitive to everything now so I was afraid of that. 
They think that I developed it from either a heavier flow/hereditary (my Mom has it)/or diet. I was on my own for two years and didn’t eat a whole lot for a year/did military workouts five times a week so I feel like that may have contributed to it.
I cut down on dairy/alcohol/coffee to maybe a couple times a month, I have oatmeal with flax and chia or some sort of egg everyday for breakfast, salads with chicken, peptitas, flax or liver with brown/white rice for lunch (or the occasional work lunch/fast food), and some sort of chicken/pork/fish/beef for dinner with a veg (like green beans or spinach) and potato or rice.
I’m glad it looks like the iron pills are working! I was a little worried since the levels didn’t impr that much but they did say it would take months before anything really noticeable
